ac_compile_parallelize_and_init: apply activation checkpointing, torch compile, and FSDP sharding to a CLIP model for distributed training
map_modules_and_blocks: apply a callable to all blocks of a list of nn.Module models in place
compile_block: torch compile a single model block with optional CUDA graph support for faster inference
compile_backbone: torch compile all blocks in a model backbone for improved training or inference speed
compile_head: torch compile all blocks and the linear projection of a model head module
